name: Phishing Attack
mitigation: Enforce MFA on all accounts. Quarterly phishing training.

name: Misconfigured S3 Bucket
mitigation: Enable AWS Block Public Access. Config rules to alert on public buckets.

name: Ransomware Attack
mitigation: Immutable backups tested monthly. EDR on all endpoints. IR runbooks.

name: Third-Party Vendor Breach
mitigation: Annual vendor assessments. Contractual breach notification clauses.

name: SQL Injection Vulnerability
mitigation: Cloudflare WAF blocks OWASP Top 10. SAST scanning in CI/CD pipeline.

name: Shadow IT - Unapproved SaaS
mitigation: Cloudflare Gateway detects unapproved apps. Approved software catalogue published.

name: Business Email Compromise
mitigation: DMARC/DKIM/SPF enforced. Dual authorisation for payments over 5000.

name: Insider Threat - Data Exfiltration
mitigation: Least privilege RBAC. Session recording on admin accounts. 90-day access reviews.

name: DDoS Platform Outage
mitigation: Cloudflare Magic Transit enabled. Auto-scaling configured. WAF rate limiting.

name: GDPR Non-Compliance
mitigation: DSAR workflow implemented. DPO appointed. Annual GDPR training.
